elements.name: Create a feature while editing a single model-state member

steps.name: The MCAD Software has an empty part with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State model states
Copy State is active and the edit scope is a single member
the user creates a rectangular sketch and extrudes it as a solid
the extrusion is computed in Copy State
its model-state indicator lists the extrusion as suppressed in Primary and Capture State
the user shows the solid using All Visible on the active view representation
the solid is absent and the extrusion row is dimmed and struck through
the solid is visible and the extrusion row is no longer struck through
